item.title: France and Germany push for EU budget deal by year-end as far-right rise threatens Ukraine aid
item.description: As Europe braces itself for a slew of tense elections in 2027, Paris and Berlin are pushing for the European Union to strike a budget deal by December 31 to lock in financial aid for Ukraine. But Thursday's talks in Brussels seem to have done little to build consensus around the bloc's next budget. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: “Tribal loyalty” works on right: “Heart on the left” sensitive to racism, antisemitism, human rights
item.description: As Jordan Bardella denies fresh allegations concerning antisemitic remarks he allegedly made as a teenager/young adult, how much damage could the affair do to Marine Le Pen's presidential prospects? Ana Navarro Pedro, correspondent for Portuguese media, believes its electoral impact may be limited, despite Le Pen's defence of Bardella and her choice of him as a future prime minister. “What they most regret in this whole episode is that Bardella is denying it,” she says of prospective Le Pen voters. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: François PICARD

item.title: New Zealand election results set up tricky talks for conservative incumbent
item.description: Conservative PM Luxon and populist coalition partners face negotiations with centrist kingmaker. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Royal crisis in Malaysia’s Negeri Sembilan eases as ruler reinstates council
item.description: Malaysia’s Negeri Sembilan state installed six new executive councillors on Friday, restoring its government and potentially drawing a line under a months-long constitutional crisis. The battle over the western Malaysian state’s throne erupted in April when four traditional chieftains declared its ruler, Tuanku Muhriz, removed and named Tunku Nadzaruddin Tuanku Ja’afar as his successor. The dispute brought down the state government, triggered an election and drew intervention from Prime Minister... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Iman Muttaqin Yusof

item.title: Malaysian radio station slammed for parodying Islamic prayer in football video
item.description: Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Religious Affairs) Dr Zulkifli Hasan has urged the management of a private radio station in Malaysia to immediately remove a viral video linking solat (Islamic prayer) to English Premier League football matches and issue a public apology to the Muslim community. State news agency Bernama reported that Zulkifli also called on the radio station to issue a public apology to the Muslim community and ensure that a similar incident does not recur. He... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: The Star

item.title: El Gobierno de Costa Rica niega la entrada al país a la relatora de la ONU que acusa a Israel de genocidio
item.description: La presidenta costarricense, Laura Fernández, es una estrecha aliada de su homólogo estadounidense Donald Trump, y desde mayo -cuando asumió el poder- mantiene acercamientos con Israel Leer Fuente: El Mundo - Internacional.
item.dc:creator: Afp

item.title: Natural England objected to a datacentre. Weeks later ministers threatened to abolish the agency
item.description: Body urged Bristol city council to reject plan because of risk to nearby protected wildlife and habitats Natural England objected to the building of a large AI datacentre near Bristol weeks before the government threatened to abolish the independent environmental adviser. The nature adviser made a significant intervention to urge Bristol city council not to grant planning permission for a 40MW datacentre at Avonmouth, because of the threat to protected wildlife and habitats at one of the UK’s most important sites for migratory birds, which is within 600 metres of the site. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Sandra Laville Environment correspondent

item.title: Lula nombra a un alto directivo de la banca privada como ministro de Hacienda de Brasil
item.description: Incluso antes de confirmarse el nombramiento, los primeros rumores bastaron para devolver la confianza a los mercados en la mayor economía de Sudamérica, temerosos después de las elecciones sobre la capacidad del gobierno de Lula para mantener el equilibrio presupuestario Leer Fuente: El Mundo - Internacional.
item.dc:creator: Afp

item.title: Could housing decide Spain's general election?
item.description: Europe correspondent Nick Beake speaks to one couple kept apart by high rents in Valencia. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Up to 1.4m UK workers risk missing out on zero-hours shake-up, say unions
item.description: Andy Burnham is warned against calls from bosses to water down employment rights legislation Andy Burnham is being warned that 1.4 million workers will be at risk of being stuck in insecure jobs if a forthcoming ban on zero-hours contracts is watered down. The prime minister is under pressure from business leaders to scale back last year’s Employment Rights Act, which is being introduced in stages over 2026 and 2027. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Richard Partington Senior economics correspondent

item.title: Spain’s 2026 election explained in maps and charts
item.description: Spaniards vote on November 29 in a snap general election. Here is how the system works, the parties and the key issues. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: New Zealand election: newcomer centrist party to decide as Luxon scrambles for a majority
item.description: The final count showed more support for minor parties on the ideological flanks than before. A total of 2.8 million votes were cast. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: Singapore reaches out to local firms amid reports of Nvidia chip shipment halt
item.description: Singapore said on Friday it was “engaging” with local businesses over tightened US export controls on advanced AI chips designed by tech titan Nvidia. But Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said he was unable to confirm reports that the US firm had halted server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries. Citing national security concerns, the United States has since 2022 restricted exports to China of Nvidia’s industry-leading chips, which are used to train and run artificial intelligence... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse

item.title: Brazil’s Lula appoints private banker as Finance Minister
item.description: Lula’s shock election win in October sent stock markets tumbling while the national currency, the real, weakened significantly Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Race hate exploded in this Spanish town last year. Now its residents are bracing for more
item.description: Torre-Pacheco’s diverse communities are fearful that the far-right Vox party will enter government after Sunday’s election Sitting on a park bench, taking in the sunny day, Naima reflected on all that had seemingly changed since she moved to Spain three decades earlier. Back then, the Moroccan national had felt warmly welcomed by Spaniards. “I had never, at any point in my life, felt like there was racism,” she said. “But now things are changing. And the blame lies with rightwing politics.” Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Ashifa Kassam in Torre-Pacheco, Murcia

item.title: New Zealand’s Opportunity Party poised to become election kingmaker
item.description: The newly-elected Opportunity party is now in a position to swing New Zealand’s next parliament to the left or right. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: New Zealand PM Luxon loses majority, centrists now kingmakers
item.description: If Christopher Luxon doesn’t strike a deal with centrist newcomers Opportunity, the country could be headed for another election Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Gambia celebra unas reñidas elecciones en pleno éxodo de cayucos hacia Canarias
item.description: El presidente Adama Barrow aspira a un tercer mandato, pero Talib Bensouda, su rival emergente, seduce a jóvenes sin empleo que no ven más salida que la emigración Fuente: El País - Internacional.
item.dc:creator: José Naranjo

item.title: Relief for Japan’s Takaichi as scandal-hit education chief survives censure motion
item.description: Japan’s Senate on Friday narrowly rejected a censure motion against Education Minister Yoshihiro Seki over his controversial fundraising events attended by bureaucrats, easing pressure on him to resign and potentially providing a temporary reprieve for Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s government. The motion, which is nonbinding, was defeated by 124 votes to 120 in a plenary session of the 248-seat upper house after being jointly submitted by opposition parties a day earlier, amid uncertainty over... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Kyodo

item.title: What will Taiwan local elections reveal about 2028 race and cross-strait shifts?
item.description: The local elections in Taiwan on Saturday will offer Beijing a window into shifting public sentiment and the island’s political trajectory ahead of its 2028 general poll, with the results potentially affecting city-level cross-strait exchanges, according to analysts. The “nine-in-one” elections – to decide the island’s mayors, county magistrates and thousands of grass-roots officials – are widely viewed as a midterm test for Taiwan’s leader William Lai Ching-te, who took office in May 2024. But... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Amber Wang

item.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls one seat short of majority in final election results
item.description: The center-right coalition won 65 seats, one short of a majority, after special votes were counted. Preliminary results had given it a two-seat edge. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.
item.dc:creator: BY REUTERS

item.title: ¿Quiebre en la relación Canadá-monarquía? Diputados de Quebec se niegan a jurar lealtad a Carlos III
item.description: Los recién posicionados diputados del partido independentista de Quebec y su primer ministro anunciaron que en la próxima legislatura no jurarán lealtad al rey Carlos III, quien sigue siendo el mandatario de los canadienses, pese a una orden del Tribunal Superior. ¿Se trata de un rechazo a la figura del monarca o a la institución británica colonialista? Lo analizamos con Marta Blackwell, vicepresidenta ejecutiva del Consejo Canadiense para las Américas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Victorian Coalition's election spending and saving explained
item.description: Victorians have now gotten a proper glimpse of how the Coalition plans to reduce spending in the state budget, if it wins the election this Saturday. Here are the key takeaways. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephanie Chalkley-Rhoden

item.title: Hobart stadium to proceed even without extra funds to cover cost increase
item.description: Tasmania's Treasurer Eric Abetz has told a parliamentary committee that the Macquarie Point stadium will proceed even without more funding from the Commonwealth or the AFL. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adam Holmes

item.title: 'I'd like to have him': Trump on Putin's possible G20 visit amid Ukraine war
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that Vladimir Putin may join the G20 summit if he decides to do so. Trump highlighted the vital role of diplomacy in addressing the ongoing Russia-Ukraine crisis. Trump also said Putin wanted to reach an agreement to end the Russia-Ukraine war, arguing that maintaining a cordial relationship with the Russian leader was important to negotiations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: Kanchan Yadav

item.title: Informe desde Caracas: Parlamento evalúa derogación de Ley Orgánica Libertador Simón Bolívar
item.description: El presidente del Parlamento de Venezuela, Jorge Rodríguez, anunció que buscará derogar la Ley Orgánica Libertador Simón Bolívar, una norma promulgada por él mismo, que castiga e inhabilita a quienes defiendan los llamados a sanciones contra el Gobierno venezolano. Nuestra corresponsal Daniella Zambrano nos amplió la información. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Argentina: Senado aprueba reforma a ley electoral para suspender las PASO
item.description: El Senado argentino aprobó una reforma a la ley electoral que suspendería las Primarias Abiertas Simultáneas y Obligatorias (PASO), unos comicios que definen quiénes son los candidatos de los partidos para las presidenciales y sirven como termómetro de popularidad. La propuesta, que debe ser votada por la Cámara, también contempla eliminar la obligatoriedad de tener debates en la primera vuelta electoral. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Will Taiwan’s referendum bring back nuclear power as chips and AI strain the grid?
item.description: Taiwan’s growing demand for electricity to sustain its semiconductor and AI industries has thrust a nuclear power referendum into the spotlight in Saturday’s local elections. The vote could also offer Taiwanese leader William Lai Ching-te a way out of a political dilemma as his administration explored the possibility of reviving nuclear power despite decades of opposition from his ruling Democratic Progressive Party, analysts said. Taiwan became nuclear-free in May last year when its final... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Lawrence Chung

item.title: New Zealand election: final results show ruling coalition needs minor party to govern
item.description: Incumbent prime minister Christopher Luxon loses majority and needs support of Opportunity party to remain in power, or country faces another election The final results of New Zealand’s general election show the incumbent rightwing coalition will need the support of a centrist newcomer party to form a government, and to avoid sending the country back to the polls. Preliminary results on 7 November handed the National party and its two coalition partners, the populist New Zealand First and libertarian Act parties, a slim two-seat majority, making the election too close to call until final… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Eva Corlett in Wellington

item.title: "A años luz": la UE no logra acercar posiciones sobre el presupuesto hasta 2034
item.description: La cumbre extraordinaria de los líderes de la Unión Europea terminó un día antes de lo previsto y sin avances, con los países del norte reclamando un presupuesto más chico y los del sur y el este resistiéndose a perder fondos. Los jefes de Estado y de Gobierno volverán a reunirse el 17 y 18 de diciembre, en una negociación que ahora también incluye la financiación de Ucrania y que Francia quiere cerrar antes de las elecciones presidenciales de 2027. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Threat from China looms large over Taiwan’s local elections
item.description: Taiwanese officials raise alarm over interference by China in elections that will shape fortunes of ruling party Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday in closely watched local elections that will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive party (DPP) as it navigates an increasingly precarious set of relationships on the global stage. Saturday’s vote will choose mayors, council members and other local leaders across 22 districts. Unlike the presidential elections, in which foreign policy is often a key issue, the local elections, held every four years , are largely focused… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Amy Hawkins and Yu-chen Li in Taipei

item.title: EE.UU. está demasiado centrado en Medio Oriente y no presiona lo suficiente a Rusia, le dice Zelensky a la BBC
item.description: El presidente de Ucrania expresa su frustración con Estados Unidos y dice que es "extraño" que Trump haya descrito a Vladimir Putin como un amigo. Fuente: BBC News Mundo.

item.description: The ousted prime minister's December homecoming plan deepens Dhaka-Delhi tensions and risks fresh unrest. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: España y los deseos e inquietudes de los migrantes de cara a las elecciones del 29 de noviembre
item.description: Tengan o no derecho a votar, el futuro de millones de extranjeros en España puede verse afectado por el resultado de las elecciones generales del 29 de noviembre. Entre migrantes que están en proceso de regularizar su situación y solicitantes de asilo, existe algo de "preocupación" porque un posible gobierno que incluya a la extrema derecha pueda dificultar su permanencia en el país. Pero también existen extranjeros nacionalizados que respaldan una política migratoria más dura. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Federico Cué Barberena

item.title: Último debate en España: Núñez Feijóo y Abascal atacaron duro a Pedro Sánchez, que se defendió con referencias a Javier Milei y Trump
item.description: Los cuatro principales aspirantes a presidir el país protagonizaron un cruce televisivo clave a tres días de los comicios generales. El jefe de Gobierno y Ada Colau, del Frente Amplio, confrontaron con los postulantes de la derecha, el Partido Popular y Vox, y cuestionaron el impacto de los recortes económicos inspirados en el presidente argentino. Fuente: Clarín - Mundo.
item.dc:creator: Clarin.com - Home

item.title: EU leaders unable to agree on budget after over 12 hours of talks: ‘zero results’
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron set an end-of-year deadline for an agreement on the European Union’s next seven-year budget after the continent’s leaders ruled out any chances for a deal to be reached at their summit on Thursday. The 2028-2034 budget – a statement on broader EU ambitions – is small, compared to national budgets, and it is financed mostly by the 27 member countries based on the size of their economies. It is likely to amount to between 1 per cent and 1.2 per cent of the EU’s... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Associated Press

item.title: El Senado argentino aprueba la suspensión de las primarias impulsadas por Milei
item.description: Este jueves en Argentina el Senado ha dado luz verde a la reforma electoral promovida por el presidente, Javier Milei. El mandatario había enviado al Congreso el proyecto de Reforma Electoral Integral, que busca suspender las primarias en las elecciones de 2027 y restringir los debates entre los candidatos a la Casa Rosada. El texto necesitaba un mínimo de 37 votos para su aprobación, pero finalmente ha obtenido 43. Un total de 29 senadores votaron en contra. La medida cuenta ahora con media sanción y, en caso de ser aprobada en la Cámara de Diputados, se convertirá en ley. El Gobierno… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
item.dc:creator: Guadalupe Piñeiro Michel

item.title: Un guiño judicial para Benjamin Netanyahu: ¿qué pasará con el primer ministro israelí?
item.description: En nuestra sección 'En Contexto' analizamos las tres causas judiciales por presunta corrupción contra Benjamin Netanyahu. El miércoles, el primer ministro israelí recibió un guiño de la justicia ya que el tribunal que lo investiga aseguró que dos de los procesos peligran y que en el tercero podrían llegar a un acuerdo. Desde el inicio del proceso, el político no cesó su intento de lograr inmunidad del Parlamento, un indulto presidencial y posponer las sesiones en los tribunales. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Dacil Lanza

item.description: El presidente se reunió con el banquero de Bradesco mientras arma el gabinete para su cuarto mandato y tras una semana de turbulencia financiera Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.description: María Corina Machado seguirá inhabilitada aunque prospere esta iniciativa, porque su impedimento para presentarse a elecciones tiene otro fundamento legal Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.title: Is Spain's snap election being rigged? Debunking viral claims
item.description: Ahead of Spain's snap election on Sunday, allegations of vote rigging - known in Spanish as "pucherazo" - are spreading widely on social media. From claims that undocumented migrants are being illegally registered to vote, to allegations that postal ballots and vote counts could be manipulated, internet users are accusing Pedro Sánchez's government of attempting to rig the election. But these claims misrepresent how Spain's electoral system works, as Vedika Bahl explains in Truth or Fake. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Vedika BAHL

item.title: 'Citizens angry with the establishment' as Spain heads to the polls
item.description: Three party leaders are vying in Spain's general election on Sunday, which leftist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez called following a parliamentary setback over housing legislation that underscored the fragility of his minority coalition government. Speaking with FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney, Javier Carbonell, Policy Analyst at the European Policy Centre, says that despite solid economic growth in Spain the population "have suffered a housing crisis and inflation, citizens are still angry with the government and the economic system regardless of macroeconomic data", adding that "in the end… Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Sharon GAFFNEY

item.title: Ecuador vota en unas elecciones locales que medirán la fuerza de Noboa frente a un correísmo sin partido
item.description: Más de 13,8 millones de ecuatorianos están llamados a las urnas el domingo 29 de noviembre para elegir alcaldes, prefectos y concejales. Las elecciones, adelantadas por el Consejo Nacional Electoral, serán un termómetro para el presidente Daniel Noboa, cuyo movimiento presenta por primera vez candidatos locales con la mira puesta en Quito y Guayaquil. Ante ello, aparece un correísmo sin partido propio y golpeado por la detención de varias figuras de la oposición. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Live: One Nation vows to oppose Victorian Coalition's sewerage privatisation
item.description: One Nation says it will use any influence it holds after the election to oppose a Coalition plan to partly privatise Melbourne's sewerage network. Follow live in our election blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: La UE sigue sin acuerdo sobre su presupuesto y Alemania exige que los 27 se comprometan a financiar a Ucrania
item.description: Bruselas busca cerrar las negociaciones antes de las elecciones presidenciales francesas de abril, mientras Macron rechaza perder “ni un solo euro” en ayudas agrícolas Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.title: Tensión entre kurdos y el Gobierno de Irak por control de campos petroleros y pasos fronterizos
item.description: Miles de manifestantes kurdos salieron a las calles de Erbil para protestar contra la intención del primer ministro de Irak de tomar el control de puestos fronterizos y campos petroleros bajo dominio del gobierno regional del Kurdistán iraquí. Los kurdos, que tienen una región autónoma, acusan al Ejecutivo iraquí de querer centralizar el país. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Informe desde Bruselas: Hernández de Coz elegido nuevo presidente del Banco Central Europeo
item.description: Pablo Hernández de Coz, exgobernador del Banco de España, será el primer español en liderar el Banco Central Europeo tras ser elegido para suceder a Christine Lagarde. La institución se enfrenta a los negociaciones de los presupuestos de 2028-2034 que se prevén muy complicadas por las divisiones entre los países por temas como las ayudas a Ucrania. Nuestra corresponsal Esther Herrera nos amplió la información. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Nigeria faces rising election violence in run up to vote
item.description: In tonight's edition, concerns are mounting that electoral violence could deter voters from taking part in Nigeria’s presidential election in January. Also, the driver of a car suspected of causing a fuel tanker to overturn on a major highway in Egypt is detained. And Sierra Leone was once considered the most dangerous place in the world to give birth. Today, maternal deaths have dropped dramatically. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Georja CALVIN-SMITH

item.title: Illa pide directivos “comprometidos” y los empresarios, menos impuestos
item.description: “El crecimiento económico debe traducirse en mejoras reales de la renta, del poder adquisitivo y del bienestar”, señala el president. Sánchez Llibre exige reformas y recortar burocracia. Garamendi reclama “paz social” y diálogo al Gobierno que surja tras las elecciones generales. Leer Fuente: Expansión - Economía.
item.dc:creator: David Casals, Rut Font

item.title: Coalition teams up with Labor to pass 20% gas reservation scheme for Australia’s largest exporters
item.description: Coalition voted in Senate to pass government’s final major piece of legislation for 2026, denying Greens’ bid for 25% tax on exports Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast A federal gas reservation scheme requiring Australia’s largest exporters to keep up to 20% of their product for domestic use will go ahead with the Coalition’s support. The opposition voted with the government in the Senate on Thursday night in a late sitting, giving Labor the numbers it needed. Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Tess Ikonomou

item.title: Sanchez's big gamble: Will Spain swing from Socialists to hard right?
item.description: For eight years, he’s been a mainstay among European leaders, one who’s snatched victory from the jaws of defeat before but has Pedro Sanchez run out of road this time? Spain's Socialist prime minister dogged by incumbent fatigue and nepotism allegations. Sanchez gambled on turning the rift in his coalition over his country's housing shortage into a referendum on his country's strong growth and calling a snap general election. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: François PICARD

item.title: Albania's youth are protesting in Flamingo Revolution, not leaving the country anymore
item.description: Youth protests against a rigid political system and corruption have shaken the government of Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama. They also show that fewer young people are willing to emigrate in search of a better future. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: France's Bardella faces new allegations of anti-Semitic comments
item.description: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella on Thursday faced new accusations of having made anti-Semitic remarks as a teenager, after French media published extracts from previously unaired conversations online. The 31-year-old top ally of French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has denied any wrongdoing after allegations emerged in September that he made conspiracist comments about Jewish people on Facebook in 2013. FRANCE 24's Solange Mougin reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Le Pen slams push for EU budget deal before French election
item.description: EU leaders locked horns over the bloc's budget at a summit meeting in Brussels on Thursday, as far-right leader Marine Le Pen slammed an "underhanded" push to lock in the long-term spending plans before French presidential elections next year. European Council head Antonio Costa turned up the pressure upon arrival at the budget talks, where heavyweight Germany is pressing for cuts as well as burden-sharing on money for Ukraine. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Brussels. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Guinea-Bissau delays elections for two years to 2028
item.description: Guinea-Bissau’s military rulers have pushed back presidential and parliamentary elections by two years, delaying the country’s promised return to civilian rule. Fuente: Africanews.
item.dc:creator: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)

item.title: Socios comerciales rechazan la amenaza de aranceles de Trump; China advierte que podría responder
item.description: La Administración estadounidense del presidente Donald Trump, amenaza con nuevos aranceles a 14 de sus socios comerciales. Una de las afectadas es la economía japonesa, acusada de subsidiar a sus industrias e inundar el mercado con "productos baratos", lo que perjudicaría las empresas estadounidenses. India, Brasil y la Unión Europea también rechazaron los argumentos de Trump para la imposición de aranceles e indicaron que no cederan a las amenazas de Washington. Por su parte, China anunció una guerra comercial y no descartó responder a Trump. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Jordan Bardella niega ser el autor de mensajes antisemitas que le atribuyen 'Le Monde' y 'Mediapart'

item.description: North Korea didn't say where the nuclear materials production factories that Kim Jong Un visited this week are located; U.S President Trump reiterated his eagerness to restore diplomacy with Mr. Kim as he visited China last week for the APEC summit Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.description: Liberal and Nationals’ pre-election policy costings also reveal that ‘air rights’ between Richmond train station and the MCG would be sold Follow our Australia politics live blog for latest updates Victorian election 2026 guide: what you need to know Confused about who to vote for?
